title: #4222 (2545d1d08) landed on stage/0.70.1 without a full apr-cli lib suite run; the proof is owned by the stage batch CI
evidence: Run on lambda: pp_llama_band_surface 4/4, test_llm 72/72, band 72/72, aprender-contracts lib 1703/1703, fmt, clippy -p apr-cli --lib -D warnings clean, cargo deny advisories ok. The full `cargo test -p apr-cli --lib` did not complete: cargo-memcap killed it at 16G (systemd unit cb-4222-lib, EXIT=101, infra#930). The only change is clap `requires = "band"` on 11 --comparator-* args in crates/apr-cli/src/extended_commands.rs, so a regression would show as a legacy `apr test llm bench` argv that now fails at parse. Unrelated flake seen in filtered runs: commands::eval::inference::execute_python_test_diagnostics_tests::verbose_stderr_does_not_deadlock_on_success (10s timeout under load).
repro: cargo nextest run --profile ci -p apr-cli --lib   # on CI or gx10, not lambda (memcap)
owner: aprender-59 (stage/0.70.1 batch CI owns the full-suite proof; cop ruling 2026-09-26)
